classification: HTTP proxy CONNECT refusal before upstream TLS
observed_error: urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden>
response_capture_limit: The original Python process exited. Its HTTPConnection retained proxy headers only in memory; no headers were printed or persisted, and the failure path closed the connection without reading the body.
supported_conclusion: The HTTPS tunnel was refused by the configured proxy path before a Hugging Face HTTPS API response could be received.
not_established: The exact proxy policy, saved allowlist rule, upstream-proxy reason or whether an allowlist expansion would suffice cannot be established from the retained error.
remaining_blocker: Parent must obtain the environment policy/status or explicit authorization for any necessary access change. No bypass was attempted.
